name: App volumes that stick
description: A WirePlumber 0.5 script, off until you turn it on, that keeps each app's volume from the mixer when the app sets its own: as it opens a stream, resumes, or moves to the next item. Spotify 1.2.95 does not need it: it takes the mixer's volume as its own.
notes: Off by default. To turn it on, set KIBBY_APP_VOLUME_GUARD=required in ~/.config/kibby/settings.env, run ./install app-volumes, then systemctl --user restart wireplumber (sound stops for about a second).
